post.text:
The ‘SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY’ trailer launch was bigger than the first ‘GTA 6’ trailer launch.

GTA 6 - 475M
Brand New Day - 718.6M https://t.co/3P87roBgNu

description.description: A high-angle, cinematic shot of Spider-Man swinging through a New York City skyscraper canyon. He is wearing his classic red and blue suit with white lenses. In the lower right corner, another character in a black and white tactical suit is seen perched on a metal landing platform. The background features tall office buildings and a street below, with sunlight glinting off one of the structures.

An illustration in a stylized video game art style featuring a man and a woman on a wooden dock. The man in the foreground wears a blue patterned short-sleeve shirt over a white tee and khaki cargo pants, aiming a handgun forward. The woman stands slightly behind him to the left, wearing a black tank top and denim shorts, holding a handgun in one hand and a silver briefcase in the other. The background depicts a coastal city with skyscrapers under a clear sky, a palm tree, a police boat in the water, and a helicopter in the air.
